description: This file defines the interface 'ResponsiveImageStyleInterface' for responsive image style entities in Drupal, including constants, method signatures for managing image style mappings, breakpoint groups, fallback styles, and related properties.

classes.name: ResponsiveImageStyleInterface
classes.description: Interface for responsive image style entities, providing methods to manage image style mappings, breakpoint groups, fallback styles, and retrieve involved image style IDs.

methods.name: hasImageStyleMappings
methods.description: Checks if at least one image style mapping is defined.

methods.name: getKeyedImageStyleMappings
methods.description: Returns mappings of breakpoint ID and multiplier to image styles.

methods.name: getImageStyleMappings
methods.description: Returns all image style mappings for the responsive image style.

methods.name: setBreakpointGroup
methods.description: Sets the breakpoint group for the responsive image style.

methods.name: getBreakpointGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the breakpoint group for the responsive image style.

methods.name: setFallbackImageStyle
methods.description: Sets the fallback image style ID.

methods.name: getFallbackImageStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the fallback image style ID.

methods.name: getImageStyleMapping
methods.description: Gets the image style mapping for a specific breakpoint ID and multiplier.

methods.name: isEmptyImageStyleMapping
methods.description: Checks if a given image style mapping is empty.

methods.name: addImageStyleMapping
methods.description: Adds an image style mapping to the entity.

methods.name: getImageStyleIds
methods.description: Retrieves all image style IDs involved in the mapping.
